title: TRACER: A Multimodal Harness for Patient Care in Hospitals
abstract: arXiv:2610.21266v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Continuous video and clinical records provide complementary information for understanding how patient behavior evolves over a hospital stay. A central challenge is how to represent behavior across the entire stay while preserving access to fine-grained visual and clinical evidence. We introduce TRACER, a training-free multimodal harness that constructs minute-level action records from video and combines them with clinical records into hourly reports. The harness equips an LLM agent with tools to query this hierarchy, inspect relevant video, and retrieve clinical records. To evaluate TRACER, we construct two benchmarks. The first contains 397 annotated one-minute clips spanning 15 atomic actions; the second poses 144 clinician-informed multiple-choice questions, grounded in 264 hours of video and clinical records from two ICU patients. translated_title: TRACER：一个用于医院患者护理的多模态工具框架
translated_abstract: 连续的视频和临床记录为理解患者住院期间的行为演变提供了互补的信息。一个核心挑战是如何表示整个住院期间的行为，同时保留对细粒度视觉和临床证据的访问能力。我们提出了TRACER，一个无需训练的多模态工具框架，它从视频中构建分钟级的动作记录，并将其与临床记录结合为小时级报告。该框架为LLM智能体配备了一系列工具，可用于查询这一层级结构、查看相关视频片段以及检索临床记录。为了评估TRACER，我们构建了两个基准测试：第一个包含397个带注释的一分钟视频片段，涵盖15种原子动作；第二个包含144道由临床医生参与设计的多项选择题，基于两名ICU患者共264小时的视频和临床记录。TRACER在动作检测上最高达到84.8%的准确率，在问答任务上达到61.0%的准确率，而最强基线仅为49.3%。
tldr: TRACER是一个无需训练的多模态框架，它将分钟级视频动作记录与临床记录分层整合，并通过为LLM智能体提供查询和检索工具，在ICU患者行为检测和临床问答基准上显著超越基线方法。
en_tdlr: TRACER is a training-free multimodal harness that hierarchically integrates minute-level video action records with clinical reports, equipping an LLM agent with query and retrieval tools to significantly outperform baselines on ICU patient action detection and clinical QA benchmarks.
